style.visual: Warm, dark and glossy. Top down pot macros in steel pots, amber sauce, one side lamp. Best reel (6,981 views, median 222) was one unbroken 16 second macro with one yellow tape label. Gaps: most reels have no hook text, none end on a finished dish reveal.
style.context: Slow cooking as craft. The sofritto series (Hour 1, only 7 hours to go; aromatics merging; the trinity is complete) is a real series. Bio promise: Homemade flavours, done properly. Casual prices.
style.copy: Sensory hook, sharp invitation, standard footer. Warm and unhurried, some Thai lines mixed into English captions. Older captions end with DM or GrabFood link in bio, which is superseded by the order app link. Rules: slash prices only, no percentages, free delivery within 2km*.

proposals.title: Lamb shank, Hour 1 of 4
proposals.hook: Hour 1 of 4. The shanks meet the pot.
proposals.visual: Top down on the pot, one side lamp. Yellow tape label 'Hour 1 of 4'. Clip 1: shanks searing, deep brown. Clip 2: onion and garlic dropping in. Crop 4:5 for the grid cover, keep the label in the centre.
proposals.caption: Hour 1 of 4. Slow braised lamb shank starts with a hard sear, because flavour is built before the lid goes on. Sweet carrots, rosemary, a gravy that coats the spoon. 6 shanks, one pot, no shortcuts. Order direct, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: No face to camera, no fast cutting

proposals.title: Slow Braised Lamb Shank: new on the menu
proposals.visual: One hero shot at 45 degrees, steam rising, the shank on a dark plate with carrots and gravy. Title card in warm amber, then no other text. Hold 6 seconds, one spoon lift to finish.
proposals.caption: Slow Braised Lamb Shank. 1 shank, sweet carrots, 300g of gravy. Falling off the bone and ready to heat. Order 2 days ahead, direct on the order app (link in the last line).
proposals.borrow: @jose.kallioinen title card, @bshnuez dish name plus components caption
proposals.avoid: No price war language, no mention of other platforms

proposals.title: The 8 hour sofritto, finished
proposals.visual: One continuous macro of the finished sauce in the pot with a wooden spoon lift. Yellow tape label 'Worth the wait', top left. Finish on the plated pasta with steam.
proposals.caption: Eight hours of onion, carrot and celery, slowly turning to amber. Then it becomes the base of every sauce we make. Worth the wait. Order the ragu direct, link in the last line.
proposals.borrow: Your own best reel formula (6,981 views)
proposals.avoid: No cuts faster than every 3 seconds

proposals.title: Loy Krathong night: a warm pot at home
proposals.hook: A quiet night in, a full pot.
proposals.visual: Soft candle glow beside a stew bowl, shot top down at dusk. No lanterns or festival graphics. Check the date before posting: sources disagree on 24/11 or 25/11.
proposals.caption: However you spend Loy Krathong, finish it with something warm. Red Wine Beef Stew, slow cooked and ready to heat. Order 2 days ahead on the order app, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: Do not post until the date is confirmed

proposals.title: Thanksgiving: the shank that does the work
proposals.visual: Lamb shank plated with carrots at 45 degrees, candle and one wine glass out of focus. Label 'Thanksgiving, sorted'. Orders close Tue 24/11, so post this earlier if you want it to sell: shoot on 20/11 and publish 21/11.
proposals.caption: Hosting this week? Let the pot do the work. Slow braised lamb shank, ready to heat and serve. Orders close Tue 24/11, 2 day lead time. Order direct, link in the last line.

proposals.title: Share a pot with someone who deserves it
proposals.visual: Slide 1: two bowls, one pot. Slide 2: the pot being lifted. Slide 3: label with the dish name and 'serves 2'. Warm lamp, dark table.
proposals.caption: Some pots are made for sharing. Pecorino and Broccoli Cream Soup, Red Wine Beef Stew, or the new lamb shank. Choose one for someone who needs a warm night. Order direct, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: No fixed footer prices that go stale

proposals.title: Why we sear before the pot
proposals.visual: Close on lamb shank hitting the oil, then the fond lifting with water. Tape label 'Brown first'. Two clips of 4s, one reveal of 4s.
proposals.caption: The dark crust on the pan is flavour. We lift every bit of it into the braise. That is the whole difference between a stew and a good stew. Order direct, link in the last line.
proposals.avoid: Do not copy exact gram posts. Share the idea, not the full recipe.
